huskar_blood_magic.name: Blood Magic
huskar_blood_magic.description:
Huskar does not have mana. Mana costs of items are converted into health costs.

Huskar's Health Costs are Magical Damage and can be reduced by Magic Resist.

huskar_inner_fire.name: Inner Fire
huskar_inner_fire.description: In a fiery rage, knocks all nearby enemies away from you to a fixed distance, dealing damage and silencing them.
huskar_inner_fire.lore: Not even Huskar's own flesh can contain the unending expansion of his life force.

huskar_burning_spear.name: Burning Spear
huskar_burning_spear.description: Huskar sets his spears aflame, dealing damage over time with his regular attack.  Multiple attacks will stack additional damage.  Each attack drains some of Huskar's health.
huskar_burning_spear.facet_huskar_nothl_conflagration: Burning Spears also burns enemies for a percentage of their max health. Costs Max Health instead of Current Health.
huskar_burning_spear.scepter_description: Burning Spears launches an additional %multishot_targets% spears onto random enemies within Huskar's attack range.
huskar_burning_spear.lore: The Sacred Warrior ignites his weaponry after marking it with his own blood - causing far greater pain than he himself feels.
huskar_burning_spear.note0: Burning Spear stacks additively when used multiple times on one target.  There is no cap.
huskar_burning_spear.note1: Huskar cannot kill himself with this skill.
huskar_burning_spear.note2: Incendiary does not deal extra Max Health Burn Damage to Roshan.

huskar_berserkers_blood.name: Berserker's Blood
huskar_berserkers_blood.description: Huskar's injuries feed his power, giving increased attack speed, magic resistance and health regen based on missing health. Health regen is a percentage of your strength.
huskar_berserkers_blood.shard_description:
Huskar can activate Berserker's Blood for a health cost to cauterize himself. Dispels Huskar, then after a delay, heals for the amount of health consumed plus an additional bonus per debuff dispelled.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
huskar_berserkers_blood.facet_huskar_cauterize: Berserker's Blood can be activated for a health cost. Dispels Huskar, then after a delay, heals for the amount of health consumed plus an additional bonus per debuff dispelled.\n\nDISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
huskar_berserkers_blood.lore: After losing his birthright, Huskar gained a lethality in physical combat that is only heightened as his own blood is spilled.
huskar_berserkers_blood.note0: Bonuses are provided linearly, no bonus at Full HP and full bonus at strictly less than %hp_threshold_max%%% HP.
huskar_berserkers_blood.reverse_custom_description: The higher the health, the stronger the hero. Increases his attack speed, magic resistance and health recovery depending on the current health. Recovery is equal to a share of the hero's agility.

huskar_life_break.name: Life Break
huskar_life_break.description: Huskar draws upon his health to break an enemy's life, leaping at a target to shatter a percentage of that hero's current health and slow both their movement and attack speed.  While leaping, Huskar is Debuff Immune with %immunity_resist%%% magic resistance.\n\nDISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
huskar_life_break.facet_huskar_bloodbath: Life Break also slows enemies in a radius around the target.
huskar_life_break.facet_huskar_nothl_transfusion: Life Break also heals friendly units in a radius around the target.
huskar_life_break.scepter_description: Forces the enemy target to attack Huskar and increases cast range.
huskar_life_break.lore: No matter the danger, Huskar thrusts himself into melees that only he can survive.
huskar_life_break.note0: If Huskar is disabled during the charge or the target moves more than 1400 units in 0.015 seconds, the charge stops.
huskar_life_break.note1: Slow works on Spell Immune units.
